superloot.options.title: SuperLoot Settings
superloot.option.chest_amount.low.toolti: 0 or 1 chest in every 256x256 block area. Applies to land you haven't explored yet.
superloot.option.chest_amount.medium.too: 1 or 2 chests in every 256x256 block area. Applies to land you haven't explored yet.
superloot.option.chest_amount.high.toolt: 2 or 3 chests in every 256x256 block area. Applies to land you haven't explored yet.
superloot.option.loot_quality.common.too: Everyday supplies: food, torches, coal, iron, simple tools.
superloot.option.loot_quality.mixed.tool: Mostly common chests, with about 1 in 4 being a rare chest.
superloot.option.loot_quality.rare.toolt: Treasure: diamonds, enchanted gear, golden apples and more.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.superloot: Scatters loot chests across the Overworld surface. Choose how many appear and how good the loot is.
